dvids.title: USS Boxer Conducts Flight Operations
dvids.desc: Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Boxer (LHD 4) conducts flight operations, Oct. 20, 2026. Boxer is deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations to support maritime security and stability in the Middle East. (U.S. Navy video)

dvids.title: Navy Medicine Sailors return home from deployment
dvids.desc: An elite, far-forward Navy Medicine surgical asset returned to U.S. soil on Oct. 17, 2026, touching down at the military air terminal at Naval Air Station Norfolk following a seven-month deployment to the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) area of responsibility.

dvids.title: Readout of U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw's Meeting with Kuwaiti Defense Leaders
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. (Oct. 19, 2026) U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw met with key Kuwaiti political and defense leaders during a trip to Kuwait City, Kuwait, Oct. 18-19.
